claims.text: Claude Code is Anthropic's terminal-native AI coding agent that reads your entire codebase
It plans changes across multiple files, writes code, runs tests, and iterates on failures autonomously
Claude Code scores 80.8% on SWE-bench, the highest for any AI coding tool
It has a 1M token context window, handles git workflows (commits, branches, PRs), and supports MCP integrations

facts.description: Claude Code is Anthropic's terminal-native AI coding agent that reads your entire codebase, plans changes across multiple files, writes code, runs tests, and iterates on failures autonomously.
facts.how_it_works: Type a task in plain language. Claude Code maps your project, plans an approach, edits files across the codebase, runs commands and tests, and asks for permission before changing anything. It stages changes, writes commit messages, creates branches, and opens PRs.
key_features: 1M token context window — reads your entire codebase
SWE-bench score of 80.8% — the highest for any AI coding tool
Plan mode: plan first, approve, then execute
CLAUDE.md project memory for conventions and rules
MCP integrations: connect Jira, Slack, databases, design tools
Subagents: spawn parallel agents on different parts of a task
Headless mode: pipe into Unix tools and CI pipelines
Scheduled tasks: run on Anthropic's infrastructure when your machine is off
facts.models: Powered by Claude 5 (Fable 5), Opus 4.8, and Haiku 4.5
facts.pricing: Claude Pro at $17/month (billed annually) includes Claude Code. Or pay-as-you-go API access at ~$3/hour.
facts.what_it_is: An autonomous AI coding agent that lives in your terminal. Not an autocomplete tool — it reads your full codebase (up to 1M tokens), plans across multiple files, writes code, runs tests, reads errors, and fixes them in a loop.
facts.where_it_runs: Terminal CLI, VS Code extension, JetBrains plugin, desktop app (macOS/Windows), and web at claude.ai/code

scenes.heading: THE AI THAT READS YOUR WHOLE CODEBASE
scenes.say: This AI reads your entire codebase — up to one million tokens. It plans changes across multiple files, writes the code, runs the tests, and fixes its own errors. All from your terminal. This is Claude Code.

scenes.heading: CLAUDE CODE
scenes.say: It's called Claude Code, from Anthropic. Not a browser extension. Not a chat window. It lives in your terminal — right where you code. It's not an autocomplete tool. It's an autonomous agent that does the whole task.

scenes.heading: HOW IT WORKS
scenes.say: Type a task in plain language. Claude Code maps your project, plans an approach, edits files across the codebase, runs commands and tests, and asks for permission before changing anything. When something fails, it reads the error, reasons about the problem, and tries again. It's a loop — plan, execute, verify, iterate. Like a developer who never sleeps.

scenes.heading: 80.8% ON SWE-BENCH
scenes.say: It scores eighty point eight percent on SWE-bench — the highest of any AI coding tool. Cursor scores around seventy two. Copilot scores lower. Seven channels covered it this week. Eighty two thousand views. The developer community has converged on it.
scenes.sub: Highest of any AI coding tool

scenes.heading: GET STARTED
scenes.say: Install with one command. npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code. Then type claude in your project directory. It works with any language, any framework, any editor. No Docker required. No complex setup. Pro plan at seventeen dollars a month includes it.

scenes.heading: THE HONEST CATCH
scenes.say: Claude Code is powerful, but it's still an AI. It will make mistakes. It will misunderstand your intent sometimes. You still need to review every change. And for the twenty percent of tasks that are genuinely hard, you're still doing the work. But for the eighty percent — refactoring, tests, migrations, bug fixes — it changes how fast you ship.
